fix: admit bounded Rust toolchain archive metadata

The pinned Rust 1.98.1 Linux std archive has 65 GNU long-name records.
Admit up to 256 extension records per archive while keeping the 64 KiB
per-record and 1 MiB total payload bounds. Report count and size failures
with separate diagnostics.
